faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Straight answers about PDR and working with us.

1.a: PDR (Paintless Dent Repair) removes dents by carefully massaging metal from behind — without filler or paint when the finish is undamaged.

2.a: If paint is cracked or chipped, or metal is severely stretched, conventional bodywork may be needed. We can still prep panels for painting.

3.q: How does a photo quote work?
3.a: Send a few clear photos (close-up and wider shots) via the form or WhatsApp. We reply with an estimate and proposed slot.

4.q: How long does a repair take?
4.a: A single parking dent often takes hours. Heavy hail may need 1–3 days. We confirm timing with your quote.

5.a: Yes — we help with hail claims and provide documentation insurers typically require.
